dbl.text: Kaito Shizuki's life in Eiganjo changes when his sparring partner Eiko chooses to study as a kami diplomat, and his new partner turns out to be the emperor herself.

When Light-Paws tells him he must choose a path, Kaito refuses to be a samurai and turns his back on his mentor, then finds Kyodai in distress, the emperor missing, and a man with a metal arm vanishing over the rooftops, and since Light-Paws will not listen to his account, Kaito resolves to leave the palace and search Kamigawa for the man himself.
His search leads to a burning warehouse where Tameshi lies mortally wounded by a metal arm, admitting that lying to Kaito was his worst mistake before he whispers the name Tezzeret and dies.

A moonfolk named Tamiyo becomes an ally, Kaito steals the Reality Chip from the lab, and the swordswoman who cuts down the mech is the emperor, who is also the Wanderer, but the lab proves to be a trap, and Tezzeret holds star-blades to Kaito's throat until the Wanderer cleaves Jin-Gitaxias and frees them.
In the last battle Tezzeret drags Tamiyo away through a portal, and Kaito knocks Risona unconscious with a thrown rock, ending the fight.

neo.text: When Kaito Shizuki is fourteen, the emperor disappears after Tezzeret attacks her in the temple of Kyodai, and Kaito leaves the castle to search for answers.
He is the emperor's closest childhood friend, though custom forbids her to reveal her name even to him, and he comes to Tameshi as a mentor and best friend for nine years.

When Satoru sends him to steal information about Tameshi's technology, Kaito's spark ignites as he contacts the kami Himoto, and he learns that Tameshi was secretly working with Jin-Gitaxias, who kills him after getting what he needed.
Kaito grabs the Reality Chip hoping for answers and charges with Tamiyo into Jin-Gitaxias's lab, where the praetor is waiting for them, and the Wanderer cuts him in half.

one.text: Kaito Shizuki enters New Phyrexia and is hypnotized by electrostatic wind until the Wanderer strikes him in the face and breaks the spell, and then the Wanderer flickers away, unable to stay on the plane.
With Nahiri he cuts a Zendikari statue free from living cables, and they reach a Mirran camp where Melira's explosive charges drop the group down toward Mirrodin.

In the Dross Pits the group follows Jace because he carries the sylex, and Kaito wants to recover it while Elspeth insists on saving their own, and later Kaito lifts the oil so the group can pass the gateway, and Tyvar tells him to take the others on to the root source.
At the Seedcore Jace prepares to activate the sylex, and Kaya and Kaito try to stop him, but Elspeth impales Jace and seizes it.
Elesh Norn then animates Jace's body, Kaito takes Luxior when it falls out, and the invasion begins.

dsk.text: Kaito Shizuki is stealing an iron scroll in Otawara, asking the spider kami's web to be unwoven by Himoto, when the Wanderer appears and tells him that Nashi has been missing for three months.

He recruits Tyvar and Niko, and the team enters the door on Ravnica into the House, where the floor opens like a mouth and he falls into darkness with Himoto clinging to him, while the Wanderer fails to catch him.
He finds himself on a burned plain and punches Jace in the face, but Jace later abandons him in a pit of gel, and Kaito planeswalks back to Ravnica.
Unable to return alone, he is helped when Proft creates an artificial Omenpath with his spark, and Kaito stabs Valgavoth through the wall with his katana.
The team escapes through the door, with Kaito covering Tyvar against a nightmare, and steps out onto Ravnica.
